pages.title: Garnite Sword
pages.text: Garnite is a tough metal, and a sword made of it will not let you down. With 8.5 attack damage, an attack speed of 1.8 and 1800 uses, this blade is a solid upgrade for any adventurer who wants to strike a little harder.

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: Two Garnite Ingots on top of a stick.
